Heat in Colombo

Colombo

A coastal capital where humid heat meets markets and harbours.

What heat does here

In the open

Heat advisories ask people to work in the shade. Market and fish workers who sell in the open often cannot.

What is in place

A plan that sees women’s work

The city has worked with the Department of Meteorology and SLYCAN Trust on guidelines for a gender-sensitive heat action plan.

What helps

Advice works when it fits how people earn a living.
